_meta.indication: PLEGRIDY (peginterferon beta-1a) is indicated for the treatment of patients with relapsing forms of multiple sclerosis.

pivotal_trials.design: Multi-center, randomized, double-blind, parallel-group, placebo-controlled trial; placebo-controlled for the first year, after which placebo patients were re-randomized to one of the pIFN groups
pivotal_trials.population: Patients aged 18 to 65 years with confirmed relapsing multiple sclerosis (McDonald criteria), EDSS 0–5.0, with at least 2 relapses in the preceding 3 years (one within 12 months of randomization)
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Annualized relapse rate (ARR) over one year, based on confirmed relapses
pivotal_trials.n: N=1512 dosed (placebo 500, peginterferon beta-1a 125 mcg every 4 weeks 500, every 2 weeks 512)
pivotal_trials.result: Adjusted ARR 0.256 for peginterferon 125 mcg every 2 weeks vs 0.397 for placebo (rate reduction 35.6%, p=0.0007); every 4 weeks ARR 0.288 (rate reduction 27.5%, p=0.0114)

nct_ctgov.title: Efficacy and Safety Study of Peginterferon Beta-1a in Participants With Relapsing Multiple Sclerosis

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (incidence ≥10% and ≥2% more than placebo): injection site erythema (62% vs 7%), influenza-like illness (47% vs 13%), pyrexia (45% vs 15%), headache (44% vs 33%), myalgia (19% vs 6%), chills (17% vs 5%), injection site pain (15% vs 3%), asthenia (13% vs 8%), and arthralgia (11% vs 7%)
target_moa: Peginterferon beta-1a is a pegylated form of interferon beta-1a; the mechanism by which it exerts its effects in multiple sclerosis is unknown.

advisory_committee.vote: Not referred to an FDA advisory committee because the safety profile is acceptable and the clinical trial design is similar to trials of previously approved relapsing MS drugs

description.text: Labeling revised to comply with the Pregnancy and Lactation Labeling Rule (PLLR)

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental biologics application provides for revisions to the Plegiridy labeling to comply with the Pregnancy and Lactation Labeling Rule (PLLRR).

description.text: Added an intramuscular route of administration for Plegridy (peginterferon beta-1a)

citations.quote: This Prior Approval sBLA provides for an intramuscular route of administration of Plerigryd. Additionally, in accordance with the Release from Postmarketing Requirement (PMR) letter dated January 26, 2021, where you were informed of your release from PMR 2760-2, all references to a pregnancy registry have been removed from labeling.

summary.text: Traditional BLA approval of a pegylated form of interferon beta-1a for relapsing forms of MS; the Division agreed at the pre-BLA meeting that the single trial 105MS301 could provide substantial evidence of effectiveness, supported by the known benefits of approved Avonex. The application was not referred to an advisory committee.

citations.quote: A pre-BLA meeting held on March 12, 2013, led to agreement with the sponsor that data from that single study (105MS301) could potentially provide substantial evidence of effectiveness.

The applicant has provided substantial evidence of effectiveness from Study 105MS301, as supported both by the known benefits and effects of approved Avonex and in the context of the consistent benefits and effects seen with various interferons for MS, for Plegridy (whether administered by prefilled syringe or autoinjector) in a dose of 125 mcg every two weeks as a treatment for relapsing forms of

This application was not referred to an FDA advisory committee because the safety profile is acceptable for the treatment of patients with relapsing forms of multiple sclerosis and because the clinical trial design is similar to that of trials of previously approved drugs for the treatment of relapsing MS.
